evals.prompt: I only want to run the swaps and ragnarok simulation stages with debug logging and a 10 minute timeout. I tried STAGES=swaps,ragnarok DEBUG=1 TIMEOUT=10m make test-simulation but it ran everything. Why?
evals.expected_output: The Makefile recipe sets STAGES=$(TEST_SIMULATION_STAGES) on the docker run line, overwriting an exported STAGES, and DEBUG/TIMEOUT are not forwarded. Use make test-simulation TEST_SIMULATION_STAGES=seed,bootstrap,swaps,ragnarok (seed/bootstrap needed for funded users and pools), or test-simulation-no-reset against a running mocknet. Stage order comes from simulationStages() in cmd/main.go.
assertions: Explains that the recipe overrides STAGES and tells the user to pass TEST_SIMULATION_STAGES instead
Says DEBUG and TIMEOUT are not forwarded by the Makefile rather than inventing their effect
Includes seed and bootstrap (or explains they are needed) when narrowing stages
Does not claim the listed stage order controls execution order

evals.prompt: Add a new simulation stage called 'thorname-renew' that registers a THORName for a user, waits a few blocks, renews it, and checks the expiry moved forward.
evals.expected_output: A new actor (actors/core or actors/features) embedding Actor, created with NewActor(name, rng), with ops appended to a.Ops, acquiring/releasing a User, returning OpResult values, querying via pkg/thornode, and a Timeout. Registered by adding a simulationStage{name, defaultOn, constructor} entry to simulationStages() in cmd/main.go at the right position; optionally added to TEST_SIMULATION_STAGES in the Makefile.
assertions: Uses the real types: Op func(*OpConfig) OpResult with OpResult{Continue, Finish, Error}; does not use types.Result, Run(ctx), Dependencies(), or c.Clients
Acquires a User with Acquire() and releases it on every exit path
Registers the stage by adding an entry to simulationStages() in test/simulation/cmd/main.go, not by adding a case to a switch
Asserts on the expiry change from live queries rather than hard-coded block heights

evals.prompt: The simulation CI job failed with 'actor timed out' on the memoless-refunds stage. How do I reproduce it locally and figure out what happened?
evals.expected_output: Read the timeout log fields (op, op_elapsed, timeout) and the dumped actor log; grab the logged random seed and rerun with RANDOM_SEED_HEX plus make test-simulation-no-reset TEST_SIMULATION_STAGES=seed,bootstrap,memoless-refunds after make reset-mocknet; inspect localhost:1317 and Bifrost :6040/status/scanner while it runs; note op errors without Finish are retried and the job is known flaky, so compare with develop.
assertions: Uses RANDOM_SEED_HEX with the seed from the 'Random seed set to' log line
Narrows with TEST_SIMULATION_STAGES (not STAGES=) and includes seed,bootstrap
Explains that an op Error without Finish is logged and retried, so the timeout's op field identifies the stuck op
